- Initial release of 旅行插头电压查询 (travel-plug-guide).
- Supports plug type, voltage, and frequency lookup for 200+ countries and regions.
- Recommends adapter types and usage tips based on departure and destination.
- Checks if specific devices are safe to use with destination voltages to prevent damage.
- All queries run locally with no external data requests or user data collection.
